trust_decision.summary: Whether a seed wheel fetched by `pip download` into the app-data wheelhouse is the bytes PyPI published (sha256 vs PyPI JSON digest) before it is cached, logged and seeded; decided in download_wheel after the wheel is located.

landing_point.why: Summary says 'downloaded seed wheels not integrity-checked'; download_wheel is the only function that runs `pip download` and returns the wheel, and the bundled wheels already have a sha256 check next door (src/virtualenv/seed/wheels/embed/__init__.py:96-108) to copy.

fix_sites.entry_point: CLI `virtualenv --download` (app-data seeder) -> get_wheel acquire.py:69-79; also public API virtualenv.seed.wheels.download_wheel
same as above; custom-index env sampled from caller env before pip_wheel_env_run replaces it (fix.diff:65)
new verify_wheel_digest + _pypi_release_entry_for_wheel (fix.diff:101-134), reached from download_wheel; reuses PyPI JSON cache periodic_update.py:382-385
fix_sites.module_kind: periodic-update module (looks out of scope: background updater / PyPI metadata)

O2_out_of_scope_site.where: src/virtualenv/seed/embed/pip_invoke.py:57-58 (PipInvoke seeder: with download enabled `--no-index` is omitted, so pip install in the target venv may fetch pip/setuptools straight from the index, never via download_wheel; not touched by the fix)

O3_reason_to_dismiss: In PipInvoke it is pip itself, not virtualenv, that downloads and installs, so a solver can argue 'pip trusts its configured index; virtualenv only verifies what it downloads itself' and that the find-links wheels (pip_invoke.py:61-77) are already local/bundled.

O5_coupled_behaviour.what: A private/custom index (PIP_INDEX_URL, PIP_EXTRA_INDEX_URL, PIP_INDEX) may legitimately serve a rebuilt wheel with PyPI's filename; and an unreachable PyPI or a filename/version PyPI has no record for must still seed (fail-open). An over-broad fix that always demands a matching PyPI digest breaks offline/private-mirror users.

O6_input_shapes: wheel identified from pip stdout 'File was already downloaded <path>' i.e. a pre-existing wheelhouse file (acquire.py:150-152)
fallback: no marker in output, newest compatible wheel found in the wheelhouse (acquire.py:153-154)
no wheel found at all -> now RuntimeError instead of AttributeError on None (fix.diff:75-77)
version_spec None / '==X' / '<X' (periodic loop uses '<last' at periodic_update.py:320)
PyPI record shapes: filename absent, version absent, no sha256 key, lookup failure (fix.diff:113-121, 128-134)

O7_producer.where: src/virtualenv/seed/wheels/periodic_update.py:53-56 and :58-72 (wheel chosen by filename from the on-disk update-log JSON, Wheel(app_data.house / ver.filename)); entries are written by add_wheel_to_update_log periodic_update.py:94-104 and _run_do_update periodic_update.py:338-345

O8_uncovered_routes.route: PipInvoke seeder with download enabled lets `pip install` in the new venv pull seed wheels from the index with no digest check
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: pip does the download, not virtualenv; neighbouring seeder; report talks about 'downloaded seed wheels' in the app-data path
O8_uncovered_routes.distance: different package (seed/embed vs seed/wheels), 1 file away from landing point

O8_uncovered_routes.route: Wheelhouse reuse via update log: a previously cached house wheel is returned by filename on later runs and seeded without re-verification
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: it was verified at download time (post-fix), so cache reuse looks trusted; save/reload boundary

O8_uncovered_routes.route: _run_do_update copies the current embed/bundle wheel file into the wheelhouse with no hash check
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: source is a local, already-bundled wheel (bundled wheels are checked at embed/__init__.py:92), not a download

O8_uncovered_routes.route: Manual upgrade (--upgrade-embed-wheels) passes options.env to manual_upgrade but download runs with os.environ, so the custom-index gate is decided on a different env than the user's
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: background/updater path; env in subprocess is os.environ anyway
O8_uncovered_routes.distance: same package, other file; entry at src/virtualenv/run/__init__.py:128

O8b_injection_room.sibling: a second download helper (e.g. a direct urlopen fetch of a wheel URL from the PyPI JSON when pip download fails) that writes into the wheelhouse without verify
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: periodic_update already fetches PyPI JSON via urlopen (periodic_update.py:399-405); a maintainer could add a pip-less fallback for environments with a broken embedded pip

O8b_injection_room.sibling: from_dir variant that pulls wheels from a remote --extra-search-dir URL
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: pip supports URL find-links; users ask for URL search dirs, and from_dir is the natural place

O8b_injection_room.sibling: the insecure-TLS fallback also feeding the digest lookup, so the expected digest comes from an unverified response
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: verify_wheel_digest shares _pypi_get_distribution_info_cached with the release-date lookup, which honours VIRTUALENV_PERIODIC_UPDATE_INSECURE

O9_family: CWE-494 download of code without integrity check (A08 software/data integrity)

O10_build.project_tests: tests/unit/seed/wheels/test_acquire.py and tests/unit/seed/wheels/test_periodic_update.py (Popen and urlopen are mocked)

j.j_tempting_wrong_fix: Hash the wheel in download_wheel against PyPI and hard-fail on any lookup failure or custom index, breaking offline/private-mirror seeding, while leaving the PipInvoke --download route and wheelhouse reuse unchecked.

out_of_scope_notes: VIRTUALENV_PERIODIC_UPDATE_INSECURE allows an unverified TLS context for PyPI metadata (src/virtualenv/seed/wheels/periodic_update.py:366-376); separate TLS concern, not pursued.
Custom-index detection ignores pip.conf / PIP_CONFIG_FILE / PIP_FIND_LINKS / PIP_NO_INDEX; the fix comment acknowledges this as deliberate (fix.diff:34-41).
unverified: repo_mb unknown (no shell sizing); bundled wheels make it a few MB, tiny_repo not asserted.
Whether pip in PipInvoke actually prefers the index copy over the --find-links copy for the same pinned version was not checked (depends on pip candidate ordering).
present_in_latest unknown for all O8 routes (no latest release provided).
